method.geometry: Hungarian: max valid IoU>=.5 cardinality, then total IoU; no predicted/GT category used
method.matching_pool: All emitted predictions vs ALL official original-TAO GT including rare, holdout and unmapped categories
method.ambiguity: Prediction with >=2 official GT at IoU>=.5 excluded after global assignment
method.supervision: Exact manual-anchor intersection and fit target class; fit or tune videos only
method.correctness: Primary emitted det_labels+1 vs GT; posterior argmax correctness separately recorded
method.pairs: Same predicted (video,local_id) AND same official GT identity; distinct images; both endpoints independently eligible
method.pair_weighting: Exhaustive pairs are descriptive diagnostics, not independent samples or training weights; report source/GT-trajectory concentration
method.oracle_identity_diagnostic: Secondary oracle scope uses heldout/nonmanual identity state; never a training/selection mask, weight or feature; omitted from supervised pair rows
method.readout: All emitted observations remain in sealed GT-free index; supervised subsets never replace readout indices
method.lag: Ordinal sampled steps and preserved original frame indices separately; no elapsed seconds inferred

limitations: Counts/pairs are descriptive support, not independent sample counts, covariance or efficacy evidence
